rule_description: Always set a user in the runtime stage of your Dockerfile. Without it, the container defaults to root, even if earlier build stages define a user.
vulnerable_code:
FROM python:3.9-alpine

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

ENV FLASK_APP=main.py
ENV FLASK_RUN_HOST=0.0.0.0

EXPOSE 8080

CMD ["flask", "run", "--debug", "--port=8080"]
